claims.text: The FDA lomitapide label says alcohol may increase hepatic fat and induce or exacerbate liver injury.
claims.quote:
Alcohol may increase levels of hepatic fat and induce or exacerbate liver injury.
Drinking more than one alcoholic drink per day is not recommended for patients taking JUXTAPID.

headline.text: The FDA lomitapide label warns that alcohol may increase hepatic fat and cause or exacerbate liver injury.

reported.text: The label describes increased hepatic fat and liver injury as possible effects of alcohol in its lomitapide warning.
